final: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer) AS share_of_all_customers, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(store_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS store_count FROM customer GROUP BY store_id)) AS multiple_of_average_store_count FROM customer GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id
